name: peiyucn-skills
description: Agent-native skills marketplace. Ships note2md — Markdown note management with Notebook→Section→Page hierarchy, slash commands, OneNote import, and smart templates — and obscura-web, web fetching and browser automation on the local Obscura engine. Works across Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex.

plugins.name: note2md
plugins.description: Markdown note management with Notebook→Section→Page hierarchy and unified slash commands. Import from OneNote, auto-learn templates from your notes, archive old content. Works with any agent — Copilot, Claude Code, or Codex.

plugins.name: obscura-web
plugins.description: Web fetching, scraping, and stateful browser sessions on the local Obscura engine (Rust headless browser, no Chromium). JS-rendered pages as clean Markdown, parallel batch scraping, screenshots/PDF, and multi-step sessions via its MCP server. Windows-first; macOS/Linux install the official binary.
